import numpy as np

theta = np.pi / 4
rotation = np.array([[np.cos(theta), -np.sin(theta)],
                     [np.sin(theta), np.cos(theta)]])

scaling = np.array([[2, 0],
                    [0, 0.5]])

shear = np.array([[1, 1],
                  [0, 1]])

combined = shear @ scaling @ rotation

points = np.array([[1, 0], [0, 1], [1, 1], [-1, 1]])
transformed_points = (combined @ points.T).T

det_combined = np.linalg.det(combined)

combined_inv = np.linalg.inv(combined)

identity_check = combined @ combined_inv

print(f"Rotation matrix:\n{rotation}")
print(f"Scaling matrix:\n{scaling}")
print(f"Combined transformation:\n{combined}")
print(f"Transformed points:\n{transformed_points}")
print(f"Determinant (area scaling): {det_combined:.4f}")
print(f"Identity check error: {np.max(np.abs(identity_check - np.eye(2))):.2e}")
